title: Peruvian tribe warns that the underground ant people are sinister
summary: Jay Anderson tells of Peruvian tribe warns that the underground ant people are sinister, about recent trip at Peru, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: they did that. That particular tribe did. They were just like, "Don't [ __ ] with it."

plain: A podcast guest, Jay Anderson, told the host Jesse Michels about a recent trip to Peru. He says a tribe there warned that beings they call the ant people, who live underground, are sinister, and their advice was simply, "Don't mess with it." The story is told because it would mean local people know of a hidden, dangerous race living below the ground.
